cards.descriptionEn: The study proposes PPO-HRAP, combining PPO with an interpretable regime prior and a reward design including a VIX-conditioned drawdown penalty. On the 2020-2022 SPY backtest, it reduced maximum drawdown from 34.10% for buy-and-hold to 18.47%, aiming to improve risk-adjusted returns.
cards.description: 该研究提出PPO-HRAP，将PPO与可解释的市场状态先验结合，并通过VIX条件化回撤惩罚等奖励设计，在2020-2022年SPY回测中把最大回撤从买入持有的34.10%降至18.47%，旨在改善风险调整后收益。
cards.summaryEn: Reinforcement learning for trading often struggles to balance upside participation and drawdown control: profit-only policies can collapse toward passive long exposure on upward-drifting assets, while overly strong risk penalties can become too defensive. The authors propose PPO-HRAP, which blends the PPO action with a regime-derived target exposure and uses a reward including a VIX-conditioned drawdown penalty. Backtests show lower drawdown than buy-and-hold, but turnover is high and cross-asset robustness is based only on single runs, requiring further validation.
cards.limitations: 证据限于2020-2022年SPY回测、五个SPY随机种子以及QQQ和DIA的单次运行；未提供交易成本敏感性和其他市场状态下的稳健性测试；高换手可能影响净收益，跨资产结论不能视为普遍成立。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If reproducible, combining an interpretable regime prior with PPO may offer a practical reward and action design for controlling drawdowns during trending markets; however, high turnover and limited cross-asset evidence mean cost sensitivity and out-of-sample validation are still needed before deployment.
keyPoints: PPO-HRAP将PPO动作与基于状态先验的目标暴露混合，奖励包含组合对数收益、VIX条件化回撤惩罚、目标暴露偏离和换手成本。
在2020-2022年SPY留出测试窗口，总收益27.62%、年化8.48%、Sharpe 0.6447，最大回撤从买入持有的34.10%降至18.47%。
五个SPY随机种子的平均总收益为0.2725±0.0109，平均Sharpe为0.6219±0.0565；QQQ和DIA仅单次运行且该方法收益与Sharpe排名第一。
cards.title: 混合状态感知策略PPO-HRAP降低交易最大回撤
keyPointsEn: PPO-HRAP blends the PPO action with a regime-derived target exposure; its reward includes portfolio log return, VIX-conditioned drawdown-increase penalty, target-exposure deviation, and turnover cost.
On the held-out 2020-2022 SPY test window, total return was 27.62%, annualized return 8.48%, Sharpe 0.6447, and maximum drawdown fell from 34.10% for buy-and-hold to 18.47%.
Across five SPY seeds, mean total return was 0.2725±0.0109 and mean Sharpe 0.6219±0.0565; for QQQ and DIA, only single runs were reported, with the method ranking first in return and Sharpe.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is limited to the 2020-2022 SPY backtest, five SPY random seeds, and single runs on QQQ and DIA; transaction-cost sensitivity and robustness across other market regimes are not provided; high turnover may affect net returns, and cross-asset conclusions should not be viewed as universally valid.
cards.titleEn: Hybrid Regime-Aware PPO-HRAP Reduces Maximum Drawdown in Trading
cards.originalTitle: PPO-HRAP: Proximal Policy Optimization with a Hybrid Regime-Aware Policy for Risk-Controlled Trading
cards.summary: 强化学习交易常难以兼顾上行参与和回撤控制：仅追求利润的策略在上涨资产上易退化为被动多头，而风险惩罚过强又会过度防御。作者提出PPO-HRAP，将PPO输出与状态推导的目标暴露混合，并使用包含VIX条件化回撤惩罚等项的奖励。回测显示其回撤低于买入持有，但换手较高，跨资产稳健性仅基于单次运行，尚待更多验证。
cards.whyItMatters: 若结果可复现，将可解释的市场状态先验与PPO结合，可能为在趋势行情中控制回撤提供一种实用的奖励与动作设计思路；但其高换手和有限的跨资产证据意味着实际部署前仍需成本敏感性和样本外验证。

cards.descriptionEn: This work releases the RED-2400 v2 family, a set of five public benchmark datasets covering Solana-native venues, cross-chain flows, and on-chain oracle behavior, accompanied by fixed-seed reproducibility scripts, SHA-256 manifests, and a CC-BY-4.0 license. Its novelty lies in constructing a reproducible Solana and cross-chain microstructure corpus within a 57-day window under a single public-blockchain observer methodology, addressing the scarcity of public record-level tape
cards.description: 该工作发布了一个名为RED-2400 v2的公开基准数据集家族，覆盖Solana原生场所、跨链资金流和链上预言机行为等五个数据集，并附带固定随机种子的复现脚本、SHA-256清单和CC-BY-4.0许可。其新意在于以单一公共区块链观察者、统一方法论在57天窗口内构建可复现的Solana与跨链微观结构语料，缓解该领域公共记录级数据稀缺的问题；有用性在于为相关实证研究提供与以太坊经典数据集互补的低门槛基准。
cards.summaryEn: The authors release and document the RED-2400 family v2, comprising five public benchmark datasets assembled by a single public-blockchain observer over a concurrent 57-day 2026 window (2026-05-08 to 2026-07-05) under one methodology using only free-tier and public feeds, with no paid data, private accounts, or trading. The five datasets characterize Pyth oracle staleness against centralized-exchange prices, an Aave utilization and Ethereum liquidation panel, spot-perpetual basis and funding coupling, a Solana CEX-versus-DEX spread tape with realized impact, and a Wormhole cross-chain source-flow tape. The authors report three descriptive findings, one honest null, and a field-completeness characterization, explicitly not presenting them as causal estimates.
cards.limitations: 数据集仅覆盖2026年5月8日至7月5日的57天窗口，由单一公共区块链观察者以免费和公开数据源构建，可能受观察者方法、数据源覆盖和时间范围限制。作者仅报告描述性发现、一个零结果和一项字段完整性刻画，明确不将其解释为因果估计。因此结论外推至其他时期、其他场所或因果机制需谨慎，且不构成投资建议。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This corpus can help lower the data barrier for Solana and cross-chain microstructure research, complementing the Ethereum-centric datasets that dominate the field. Its public, reproducible benchmark family may support more consistent empirical comparisons, but the authors explicitly present the findings as descriptive rather than causal, limiting direct relevance for strategy inference or investment decisions.
keyPoints: 发布RED-2400 v2五个公开基准数据集，覆盖Pyth预言机陈旧度、Aave清算与利用率、现货-永续基差、Solana CEX-DEX价差与Wormhole跨链流。
数据在2026-05-08至2026-07-05的57天并发窗口内由单一公共区块链观察者采集，仅用免费和公开数据源，不涉及付费数据、私有账户或交易。
提供固定随机种子复现脚本、SHA-256清单和CC-BY-4.0许可，强调可复现性和公开可用性。
cards.title: RED-2400 v2：Solana与跨链微观结构公开数据集家族
keyPointsEn: Releases five public benchmark datasets in RED-2400 v2 covering Pyth oracle staleness, Aave liquidations and utilization, spot-perpetual basis, Solana CEX-DEX spreads, and Wormhole cross-chain flows.

Data were collected by a single public-blockchain observer over a concurrent 57-day window from 2026-05-08 to 2026-07-05, using only free-tier and public feeds with no paid data, private accounts, or trading.
Provides fixed-seed reproducibility scripts, SHA-256 manifests, and a CC-BY-4.0 license, emphasizing reproducibility and public availability.
cards.limitationsEn: The datasets cover only a 57-day window from 2026-05-08 to 2026-07-05, were built by a single public-blockchain observer using free-tier and public feeds, and may be constrained by observer methodology, source coverage, and time range. The authors report only descriptive findings, one null result, and a field-completeness characterization, explicitly not interpreting them as causal estimates. Extrapolation to other periods, venues, or causal mechanisms should therefore be cautious, and the work does not constitute investment advice.
cards.titleEn: RED-2400 v2: A Public Dataset Family for Solana and Cross-Chain Microstructure
cards.originalTitle: A Multi-Venue Solana/DeFi Microstructure Data Corpus: The RED-2400 Family v2
cards.summary: 作者发布并记录了RED-2400家族v2，包含五个公开基准数据集，由单一公共区块链观察者在2026年5月8日至7月5日共57天窗口内以统一方法组装，仅使用免费层和公共数据源，不涉及付费数据、私有账户或交易。五个数据集分别刻画Pyth预言机相对中心化交易所价格的陈旧度、Aave利用率和以太坊清算面板、现货-永续基差与资金费率耦合、Solana CEX对DEX价差带及已实现冲击、Wormhole跨链源流消息。作者报告三项描述性发现、一个诚实的零结果和一项字段完整性刻画，并明确不将其作为因果估计。
cards.whyItMatters: 该语料有助于降低Solana和跨链微观结构研究的数据门槛，补充以太坊为中心的现有数据集。其公开、可复现的基准家族可能支持更一致的实证比较，但作者明确所述发现均为描述性而非因果估计，因此对策略推断或投资决策的直接参考价值有限。

cards.descriptionEn: This tutorial shows how to build a dots-style, always-on AI assistant using Pi and pi-gateway, with a choice of models on a VPS or another always-on machine. It walks through agent workspaces, skills, Google Workspace access, and a Telegram gateway with local SQLite session routing, offering direct reference value for developers who want to self-host a personal assistant or research agent.
cards.description: 这篇教程展示如何用Pi和pi-gateway搭建类dots风格的常驻AI助手，支持自选模型并部署在VPS等常开机设备上。它提供了从工作区、技能、Google Workspace接入到Telegram网关与本地SQLite会话路由的完整步骤，对希望自托管个人助手或研究代理的开发者有直接参考价值。
cards.summaryEn: The tutorial demonstrates building an always-on assistant centered on Pi and connected to Telegram via pi-gateway, covering agent workspaces, skills, Google Workspace access, and local SQLite-based session routing. The author shows a personal assistant and a research agent as examples, and notes that extending the gateway to more platforms and automations is future work, not built-in features demonstrated here. This is an objective overview of the video content and does not constitute independent verification of its practicality or effectiveness.
cards.limitations: 内容来源是教程视频，未提供独立基准测试、性能数据或安全审计；示例效果依赖所选模型、部署环境与配置，视频中未逐一验证。Telegram研究代理使用Kimi K3，但模型可用性、成本及实际效果可能变化。教程中提到的平台扩展与自动化属于未来工作，并非当前已实现的内置功能。任何部署都需自行评估隐私、权限与运维风险。
cards.whyItMattersEn: For those who want a self-hosted, customizable, and always-on personal AI assistant, this tutorial offers a practical path based on open-source components, with the ability to connect custom models and Telegram. It highlights engineering considerations such as local session storage and workspace isolation, helping assess whether such an approach fits a given scenario.
keyPoints: 使用Pi和pi-gateway在VPS或其他常开机设备上构建常驻AI助手，模型可自选。
教程覆盖代理工作区、技能、Google Workspace访问，以及Telegram消息网关与本地SQLite会话路由。
演示了个人助手和研究代理，并指出多平台与自动化扩展属于未来方向，当前未内置。
cards.title: 开源常驻AI助手搭建：Pi与Telegram网关教程
keyPointsEn: Build always-on AI assistants with Pi and pi-gateway on a VPS or another always-on machine, using your choice of models.
The tutorial covers agent workspaces, skills, Google Workspace access, and a Telegram message gateway with local SQLite session routing.
It demonstrates a personal assistant and a research agent, and notes that multi-platform and automation extensions are future directions, not built-in features.
cards.limitationsEn: The source is a tutorial video and provides no independent benchmarks, performance data, or security audits; example outcomes depend on the chosen model, deployment environment, and configuration, which are not individually verified in the video. The Telegram research agent uses Kimi K3, but model availability, cost, and actual performance may change. Platform extensions and automations mentioned in the tutorial are future work, not currently implemented built-in features. Any deployment requires self-assessment of privacy, permissions, and operational risks.
cards.titleEn: Building an Open-Source Always-On AI Assistant with Pi and a Telegram Gateway
cards.originalTitle: Build Your Own Open-Source Dots with Pi and Telegram
cards.summary: 教程演示了以Pi为核心、通过pi-gateway连接Telegram的常驻助手搭建流程，涵盖代理工作区、技能配置、Google Workspace访问以及基于本地SQLite的会话路由。作者展示了个人助手和研究代理两个示例，并说明未来可扩展更多平台与自动化，但这些扩展属于未来工作，并非已内置功能。以上是对视频内容的客观概述，不代表对其实用性或效果的独立验证。
cards.whyItMatters: 对于希望自托管、可定制且常驻在线的个人AI助手的人来说，该教程提供了一条基于开源组件、可接入自有模型与Telegram的实践路径，并强调了本地会话存储与工作区隔离等工程考量，有助于评估这类方案是否适合自身场景。

cards.descriptionEn: This work proposes Function-Structured Graph Reinforcement Learning (FSG-RL), connecting subproblem graphs and Python implementations via multi-verifier feedback. The novelty lies in using executable verifiers to provide intermediate process rewards. Its usefulness is shown by improving final-answer accuracy from 43.25% to 67.50% and full solution success from 32.25% to 52.25% under a unified evaluation protocol.
cards.description: 该工作提出函数结构图强化学习（FSG-RL），将子问题图与Python实现通过多验证器反馈连接，新意在于用可执行验证器提供中间过程奖励。其有用性体现在：在统一评估协议下，最终答案准确率从43.25%提升至67.50%，完整解题成功率从32.25%提升至52.25%。
cards.summaryEn: Fact: FSG-RL first uses supervised fine-tuning to let the policy generate code from function graphs, then optimizes with GRPO using answer-gated rewards and span-level credit assignment, supporting teacher supervision and structured memory. Author's view: the framework can leverage executable verifiers to improve mathematical reasoning, and gains extend beyond generating correctly formatted code.
cards.limitations: 证据边界：结果基于作者从GSM8K、MathQA、MATH、Omni-MATH构建的特定基准，未在更广泛或真实场景中验证；未探讨计算成本、验证器覆盖范围及对教师监督的依赖；长期泛化性和鲁棒性尚不明确。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work shows how to combine executable verifiers with reinforcement learning to provide finer-grained feedback on intermediate steps in mathematical reasoning, potentially advancing more reliable algorithmic mathematical reasoning systems.
keyPoints: FSG-RL连接子问题图、Python实现与多验证器反馈。
GRPO使用答案门控奖励和跨度级信用分配进行优化。
在GSM8K、MathQA、MATH、Omni-MATH构建的基准上，GRPO将最终答案准确率从43.25%提至67.50%，完整解题成功率从32.25%提至52.25%。
cards.title: 函数结构强化学习结合可执行验证器提升数学推理
keyPointsEn: FSG-RL connects subproblem graphs, Python implementations, and multi-verifier feedback.
GRPO optimizes with answer-gated rewards and span-level credit assignment.
On a benchmark built from GSM8K, MathQA, MATH, and Omni-MATH, GRPO improves final-answer accuracy from 43.25% to 67.50% and full solution success from 32.25% to 52.25%.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundary: results are based on a specific benchmark built by the authors from GSM8K, MathQA, MATH, and Omni-MATH, not validated on broader or real-world scenarios; computational cost, verifier coverage, and reliance on teacher supervision are not explored; long-term generalization and robustness remain unclear.
cards.titleEn: Function-Structured Reinforcement Learning with Executable Verifiers Improves Mathematical Reasoning
cards.originalTitle: Function-Structured Reinforcement Learning with Executable Verifiers for Mathematical Reasoning
cards.summary: 论文事实：FSG-RL先用监督微调让策略从函数图生成代码，再用GRPO结合答案门控奖励和跨度级信用分配进行优化，并支持教师监督和结构化记忆。作者观点：该框架能利用可执行验证器改进数学推理，且增益不仅限于生成格式正确的代码。
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作展示了如何将可执行验证器与强化学习结合，为数学推理中的中间步骤提供更细粒度反馈，可能推动更可靠的算法数学推理系统发展。

cards.descriptionEn: The study introduces a benchmark of 500 synthetic non-small cell lung cancer cases and finds pervasive over-refusal in eight LLM configurations on partially supported labels (83.3-100% failure), then proposes a seven-module deterministic framework reducing over-refusal to 6.7%.
cards.description: 该研究构建了500例合成非小细胞肺癌病例的基准测试，发现八种LLM配置在部分支持标签上普遍出现过度拒绝（83.3-100%失败），并提出了七模块确定性框架将过度拒绝降至6.7%。
cards.summaryEn: OpenMTB-Audit is a benchmark with 500 synthetic NSCLC cases spanning five adversarial error categories and four safety labels to evaluate LLM safety in molecular tumor boards. Testing eight LLM configurations reveals over-refusal: all fail to retain the Partially Supported label in 83.3-100% of true cases, achieving high safety scores via label collapse rather than calibrated reasoning. The proposed MTB-AuditAgent reduces over-refusal to 6.7% with 91.2% accuracy (95% CI: 88.6-93.6%), but a two-oncologist annotation study finds disagreement at the boundary between information sufficiency and treatment optimization.
cards.limitations: 结论基于500例合成非小细胞肺癌病例，可能无法完全反映真实临床复杂性和其他癌种；仅评估了八种LLM配置，泛化性有限；双肿瘤学家标注研究仅涉及两名专家，分歧分析可能不具广泛代表性；MTB-AuditAgent的91.2%准确率需在更大多样化数据集上验证。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The study exposes the risk that LLMs may mask reasoning deficiencies through label collapse in clinical safety evaluation and provides a deterministic framework to reduce over-refusal, offering an evaluation tool and improvement direction for safe deployment of AI in molecular tumor boards.
keyPoints: OpenMTB-Audit包含500例合成非小细胞肺癌病例，覆盖五种对抗性错误类别和四种安全标签。
八种LLM配置在部分支持病例中过度拒绝率达83.3-100%，高安全分源于标签坍缩而非临床校准。
MTB-AuditAgent七模块框架将过度拒绝降至6.7%，准确率达91.2%（95% CI: 88.6-93.6%）。
cards.title: OpenMTB-Audit揭示LLM分子肿瘤板评估过度拒绝问题
keyPointsEn: OpenMTB-Audit contains 500 synthetic NSCLC cases covering five adversarial error categories and four safety labels.
All eight LLM configurations showed over-refusal in 83.3-100% of true Partially Supported cases, with high safety scores arising from label collapse rather than clinical calibration.
The MTB-AuditAgent seven-module framework reduces over-refusal to 6.7% and achieves 91.2% accuracy (95% CI: 88.6-93.6%).
cards.limitationsEn: Conclusions are based on 500 synthetic NSCLC cases and may not fully reflect real clinical complexity or other cancer types; only eight LLM configurations were evaluated, limiting generalizability; the two-oncologist annotation study involves only two experts, so disagreement analysis may not be broadly representative; the 91.2% accuracy of MTB-AuditAgent requires validation on larger, more diverse datasets.
cards.titleEn: OpenMTB-Audit Exposes Over-Refusal and Clinical Expert Perspectives in LLM-Based Molecular Tumor Board Safety Evaluation
cards.originalTitle: OpenMTB-Audit: Exposing Over-Refusal and Clinical Expert Perspectives in LLM-Based Molecular Tumor Board Safety Evaluation
cards.summary: 研究提出OpenMTB-Audit基准，涵盖五种对抗性错误类别和四种安全标签，用于评估LLM在分子肿瘤板场景中的安全性。实验显示所有测试的LLM配置在真实部分支持病例中无法保留该标签的比例高达83.3-100%，通过标签坍缩获得高聚合安全分而非临床校准推理。作者开发MTB-AuditAgent框架，将过度拒绝降至6.7%，准确率达91.2%，但双肿瘤学家标注研究发现分歧集中在信息充分性与治疗优化边界。
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究揭示了LLM在临床安全评估中通过标签坍缩掩盖推理缺陷的风险，并提供了可降低过度拒绝的确定性框架，为AI辅助分子肿瘤板的安全部署提供了评估工具和改进方向。

cards.descriptionEn: This study proposes a Frequency-aware Decomposition Network (FDN) that splits wrench prediction spectrally into a low-frequency trend and a high-frequency residual to address the insufficient high-frequency estimation and delay-induced staleness of existing sensorless methods in rapid-contact tasks. Its value lies in reducing high-frequency amplitude error on real grinding data without requiring an F/T sensor or an identified robot model.
cards.description: 该研究提出频率感知分解网络（FDN），将力/力矩预测按频谱拆分为低频趋势和高频残差分别建模，以解决现有无传感器方法在快速接触任务中高频信号估计不足及通信延迟导致估计过时的问题。其价值在于无需力/力矩传感器和已辨识的机器人模型，即可在真实研磨数据上显著降低高频幅值误差。
cards.summaryEn: Existing sensorless wrench estimation methods based on proprioception perform well in slow interaction tasks, but their low-pass characteristics struggle to capture the high-frequency signals needed for rapid-contact tasks such as grinding, and communication delays can make their estimates outdated. The authors propose a Frequency-aware Decomposition Network (FDN) that spectrally decomposes the wrench horizon into a low-frequency trend and a high-frequency residual, estimated by pointwise regression and a learned conditional distribution, respectively, in a multi-step-ahead manner. On real-world grinding data from a 6-DoF hydraulic manipulator, FDN reduces high-frequency amplitude error by up to 47% and estimates a 1,000 ms horizon within 11 ms on a single CPU thread.
cards.limitations: 证据主要来自作者自研6自由度液压机械臂的真实研磨数据，尚未在更广泛的机器人平台、接触任务或传感器配置上验证。高频幅值误差降低47%是在假定时间延迟下相对特定基线取得的，实际部署中的延迟分布、噪声特性与任务变化可能影响效果。多步超前估计可行性与11毫秒/1000毫秒时域的结论基于单CPU线程设定，未涵盖其他计算平台或实时控制闭环的端到端表现。迁移学习仅作为探索性研究，低频误差降低8%而高频动态表现出领域特异性，说明跨域泛化仍有限。该研究不构成任何投资建议。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Sensorless wrench estimation can avoid expensive and fragile F/T sensors. Reliably estimating high-frequency wrench in vibration-rich rapid-contact tasks and supporting multi-step-ahead prediction could help enable contact-aware control in deployments with communication delays. This work offers a decomposition-learning approach for high-frequency dynamics modeling and delay compensation.
keyPoints: FDN将力/力矩预测按频谱拆分为低频趋势和高频残差，分别用逐点回归与学习到的条件分布建模，并利用频率感知层施加频带分解先验、自适应增强输入频率幅值。
在6自由度液压机械臂的真实研磨数据上，FDN在假定时间延迟下将高频幅值误差较基线最多降低47%，同时保持有竞争力的低频逐点精度。
FDN支持多步超前估计，可在单CPU线程11毫秒内估计1000毫秒时域；消融研究支持其设计选择，探索性迁移学习显示低频动态可迁移而高频动态具领域特异性。
该方法在估计阶段无需已辨识的机器人模型，也无需力/力矩传感器。
cards.title: 面向振动密集型接触任务的频率感知无传感器力估计学习
keyPointsEn: FDN spectrally decomposes wrench prediction into a low-frequency trend and a high-frequency residual, modeled by pointwise regression and a learned conditional distribution, respectively, with frequency-aware layers imposing band decomposition priors and adaptively enhancing input frequency amplitudes.

On real-world grinding data from a 6-DoF hydraulic manipulator, FDN reduces high-frequency amplitude error by up to 47% over baselines under assumed time delays while maintaining competitive low-frequency pointwise accuracy.

FDN supports multi-step-ahead estimation, estimating a 1,000 ms horizon within 11 ms on a single CPU thread; ablation studies support its design choices, and an exploratory transfer study shows low-frequency dynamics are transferable while high-frequency dynamics appear domain-specific.
The method requires neither an identified robot model nor an F/T sensor during estimation.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence mainly comes from real-world grinding data on the authors' 6-DoF hydraulic manipulator and has not been validated on a broader range of robot platforms, contact tasks, or sensor configurations. The 47% reduction in high-frequency amplitude error is relative to specific baselines under assumed time delays, and actual delay distributions, noise characteristics, and task variations may affect performance. Conclusions about multi-step-ahead feasibility and the 11 ms per 1,000 ms horizon are based on a single CPU thread and do not cover other computing platforms or closed-loop real-time control. The transfer study is exploratory: low-frequency error is reduced by 8% while high-frequency dynamics appear domain-specific, indicating limited cross-domain generalization. This study does not constitute investment advice.
cards.titleEn: Frequency-aware decomposition learning for sensorless wrench estimation in vibration-rich robotic contact
cards.originalTitle: Frequency-aware decomposition learning for sensorless wrench estimation in vibration-rich robotic contact
cards.summary: 现有基于本体感知的无传感器力/力矩估计方法在缓慢交互任务中表现良好，但因低通特性难以捕捉研磨等快速接触任务所需的高频信号，且通信延迟会让估计结果过时。作者提出频率感知分解网络（FDN），将力/力矩时域按频谱分解为低频趋势与高频残差，分别用逐点回归和学习到的条件分布进行多步超前估计。在6自由度液压机械臂的真实研磨数据上，FDN在高频幅值误差上最多降低47%，并能在单CPU线程11毫秒内估计1000毫秒时域。
cards.whyItMatters: 无传感器力/力矩估计可避免使用昂贵且易损的力/力矩传感器。若能在振动密集的快速接触任务中可靠估计高频力/力矩并支持多步超前预测，将有助于在存在通信延迟的部署场景下实现接触感知控制。该工作为高频动态建模和延迟补偿提供了一种可参考的分解学习思路。

cards.descriptionEn: This project offers a single CLI for AI agents to read and search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili and Xiaohongshu, claiming zero API fees. Its novelty lies in consolidating multi-platform access into one command-line channel, which is directly relevant to developers building agents that need external live content.
cards.description: 该项目以单一 CLI 为 AI 代理提供读取和搜索 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、Bilibili、小红书等平台的能力，宣称零 API 费用。新意在于将多平台信息获取整合为一条命令行通道，对需要外部实时内容的代理开发者有直接参考价值。
cards.summaryEn: Agent-Reach, a GitHub Trending project, describes itself as giving AI agents the ability to see the whole internet, reading and searching multiple social and content platforms through one CLI with no API fees. These capability claims come from the project's own description and have not been independently tested or code-audited.
cards.limitations: 当前仅有项目自述，未提供实测数据、代码审计或平台合规评估；零 API 费用是否长期成立、抓取方式是否违反各平台条款、数据完整性与稳定性均未经验证。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If the capability works reliably, agent developers could obtain multi-source public content without integrating each platform API or paying fees individually, though real usability depends on implementation, platform rules and ongoing maintenance.
keyPoints: 以单一 CLI 统一访问 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、Bilibili、小红书等平台
项目自述强调零 API 费用
定位是给 AI 代理补充互联网信息读取与搜索能力
cards.title: Agent-Reach 让 AI 代理无需 API 费用即可读取多个平台
keyPointsEn: Provides unified CLI access to Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili and Xiaohongshu
Project description emphasizes zero API fees
Positioned to add internet reading and search capabilities to AI agents
cards.limitationsEn: Only the project's own description is available; no benchmark data, code audit or platform-compliance review is provided. Whether zero API fees remain true over time, whether scraping methods violate platform terms, and data completeness and stability are all unverified.
cards.titleEn: Agent-Reach lets AI agents read multiple platforms without API fees
cards.summary: GitHub Trending 项目 Agent-Reach 的简介称其为 AI 代理提供“看见整个互联网”的能力，可读取和搜索多个社交与内容平台，并通过单一 CLI 使用、不支付 API 费用。上述能力描述来自项目自述，尚无独立评测或代码审计验证。
cards.whyItMatters: 如果该能力可稳定运行，代理开发者可以在不逐一对接各平台 API 和承担费用的情况下获取多源公开内容，但实际可用性取决于项目实现、平台规则与后续维护。

cards.descriptionEn: The study translates short-term NGFS climate scenarios into changes in obligor default risk through a structural credit risk model, simulates joint defaults with Monte Carlo methods using principal components for dependence, and feeds the resulting default-probability estimates into a constrained optimization of lending allocation. Its novelty lies in mapping scenario-dependent climate shocks to the drift of firm value, allowing default distributions and allocation patterns t
cards.description: 该研究将 NGFS 短期气候情景通过结构性信用风险模型转化为债务人违约概率的变化，并用蒙特卡洛模拟联合违约、以主成分捕捉相依性，进而驱动带约束的优化来考察信贷配置。新意在于把情景依赖的气候冲击映射到企业价值漂移项，从而在同一框架内比较不同 NGFS 情景下的违约分布与配置模式；对银行而言，可用于把 NGFS 情景落到行业层面信用风险，并支持 ICAAP 与气候压力测试的前瞻性叠加。
cards.summaryEn: The paper develops a framework to assess the loan portfolio budget in credit portfolios exposed to climate risk over a 3-5 year horizon, using short-term NGFS scenarios to translate transition and physical risk pathways into changes in obligor default risk. Firm performance is modeled in a structural credit risk framework where scenario-dependent climate shocks adjust the drift of firm value dynamics, default occurs when firm value falls below a liability threshold, and joint defaults are simulated via Monte Carlo with dependence captured by principal components. Resulting default-probability estimates inform a constrained optimization of lending allocation across exposures; the author notes that scenario choice affects model-implied default probabilities and the resulting risk-return tradeoff, and that the rankings are model-implied and calibration-dependent rather than empirical rankings of climate-scenario severity.
cards.limitations: 论文结果基于结构性信用风险模型与基准合成组合，违约概率分布、上尾风险与配置模式的排序均为模型隐含且依赖校准，不能当作气候情景严重程度或真实风险高低的经验排序。气候与企业层面数据颗粒度有限，情景到违约风险的传导依赖建模假设；框架虽透明并声明可随数据改进而细化，但当前结论的可迁移性与稳健性仍需在真实组合与更细数据下检验。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The framework helps banks link NGFS scenarios to sector-level credit risk and portfolio loss outcomes, and can support ICAAP and climate stress testing by highlighting exposures most sensitive to climate risk, adding a forward-looking overlay to existing models. It is intended as a transparent analytical tool that can be refined with better data, not as a final judgment on scenario severity or allocation quality.
keyPoints: 框架将 NGFS 短期情景映射为结构性信用风险模型中企业价值漂移项的变化，违约由企业价值跌破负债阈值触发。
联合违约通过蒙特卡洛模拟生成，相依性由主成分捕捉，所得违约概率用于带约束的贷款配置优化。
在基准合成组合中，HWTP 产生最高均值与上尾违约概率，SWUC 产生最低均值与中位数违约概率，但作者强调这是模型隐含且依赖校准的结果。
cards.title: NGFS 情景下气候感知信贷配置的蒙特卡洛框架
keyPointsEn: The framework maps short-term NGFS scenarios to changes in the drift of firm value in a structural credit risk model, with default triggered when firm value falls below a liability threshold.

Joint defaults are generated via Monte Carlo simulation with dependence captured by principal components, and the resulting default-probability estimates feed a constrained optimization of lending allocation.

In the benchmark synthetic portfolio, HWTP produces the highest mean and upper-tail default probabilities while SWUC produces the lowest mean and median default probabilities, but the author stresses these are model-implied and calibration-dependent.
The approach offers a transparent tool that can be refined as more granular climate and firm-level data become available.
cards.limitationsEn: The results are based on a structural credit risk model and a benchmark synthetic portfolio; the default-probability distributions, upper-tail risk, and lending allocation patterns are model-implied and calibration-dependent, and should not be read as empirical rankings of climate-scenario severity or real risk levels. Climate and firm-level data granularity is limited, and the transmission from scenarios to default risk relies on modeling assumptions; although the framework is transparent and stated to be refinable as data improve, the transferability and robustness of the current conclusions still require testing on real portfolios and finer data.
cards.titleEn: A Monte Carlo framework for climate-aware lending allocation under NGFS scenarios
cards.originalTitle: Climate aware lending allocation under NGFS scenarios - A Monte Carlo approach
cards.summary: 论文提出一个评估气候风险敞口信贷组合 3 至 5 年预算的框架，用 NGFS 短期情景把转型与物理风险路径转成债务人违约风险变化。作者在结构性信用风险模型中让情景依赖的气候冲击调整企业价值动态的漂移项，企业价值低于负债阈值即违约，联合违约用蒙特卡洛模拟并以主成分捕捉相依性。基于所得违约概率估计进行带约束优化，以考察跨敞口的贷款配置；作者指出情景选择会影响模型隐含的违约概率和风险收益权衡，并明确这些排序是模型隐含且依赖校准的，而非对气候情景严重程度的经验排序。
cards.whyItMatters: 该框架帮助银行把 NGFS 情景与行业层面信用风险及组合损失结果连接起来，可用于 ICAAP 和气候压力测试，识别对气候风险最敏感的敞口，并为现有模型增加前瞻性叠加。它提供的是一种透明、可随更细颗粒度气候与企业数据 refinement 的分析工具，而非对情景严重程度或配置优劣的最终判断。

cards.descriptionEn: FloWright treats the workflow itself as an optimization harness and uses hierarchical, structure-aware rewards so that a workflow generator and other agent roles can co-evolve under sparse outcome signals; DataWright further converts existing datasets into harder workflow-level tasks, improving small open models across several domains.
cards.description: FloWright 将工作流本身作为优化框架，通过层级式结构感知奖励，让工作流生成器与其他智能体角色在稀疏结果信号下共同进化，并配套 DataWright 将现有数据集转化为更高难度的工作流级任务，在多个领域提升小规模开放模型表现。
cards.summaryEn: The paper notes that existing multi-agent workflow training usually optimizes only the workflow generator while other agents that build or execute the workflow remain fixed, even though every outcome depends on all of them and a single sparse score cannot attribute failure. The authors propose FloWright, which leverages the workflow as a harness and introduces a hierarchical, structure-aware reward paradigm enabling one role to self-evolve and two or more roles to co-evolve, with no additional models, labels, or executions. Across document, slide, chart, code, math, and finance tasks, small open models trained with FloWright are reported to improve by up to +7.41%, with co-evolving (+5.03%) outperforming optimizing only one role (+2.83%), though these results are limited to the paper's experimental settings.
cards.limitations: 论文报告的提升幅度与协同进化优势仅基于其选定的文档、幻灯片、图表、代码、数学与金融任务，未说明是否适用于其他领域、模型规模或真实部署环境。摘要未提供任务难度、基线选择、统计显著性和失败案例等细节，因此不能推断 FloWright 具有普遍泛化性，也不能将其视为投资或生产决策依据。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The effectiveness of multi-agent workflows depends on all participating roles, yet outcome feedback is often sparse and hard to attribute. This work offers a training approach that does not require extra models, labels, or executions, turning workflow structure into assignable reward signals and providing a testable path for coordinated multi-role optimization.
keyPoints: FloWright 用层级式、结构感知的奖励把单一稀疏结果信号分解到不同角色，支持自进化与多角色协同进化。
协同进化多个角色带来的提升（+5.03%）高于只优化一个角色（+2.83%），说明优化范围影响效果。
DataWright 将已有数据集转化为更高难度的工作流级任务，以缓解常见数据对单智能体过于简单的问题。
cards.title: 多智能体工作流优化：FloWright 实现角色协同进化
keyPointsEn: FloWright uses hierarchical, structure-aware rewards to decompose a single sparse outcome signal across roles, supporting self-evolution and multi-role co-evolution.
Co-evolving multiple roles yields a larger gain (+5.03%) than optimizing only one role (+2.83%), indicating that the scope of optimization matters.
DataWright converts existing datasets into harder workflow-level tasks to address the common issue that data are easy for a single agent.
cards.limitationsEn: The reported improvements and the advantage of co-evolution are based only on the selected document, slide, chart, code, math, and finance tasks, and it is not stated whether they generalize to other domains, model scales, or real-world deployments. The abstract lacks details on task difficulty, baselines, statistical significance, and failure cases, so FloWright should not be assumed to be universally generalizable, nor should these results be used as a basis for investment or production decisions.
cards.titleEn: Optimizing Multi-Agent Workflows: FloWright Enables Role Co-Evolution
cards.originalTitle: It Takes Workflows to Evolve Better Workflows
cards.summary: 论文指出，现有多智能体工作流训练通常只优化工作流生成器，而负责构建或执行工作流的其他智能体保持固定，但最终结果依赖所有角色，且单一稀疏得分无法定位失败归因。作者提出 FloWright，利用工作流作为优化脚手架，引入层级式结构感知奖励，使单角色可自进化、两个及以上角色可协同进化，无需额外模型、标签或执行。实验覆盖文档、幻灯片、图表、代码、数学与金融任务，报告小规模开放模型性能最高提升 +7.41%，协同进化（+5.03%）优于仅优化单一角色（+2.83%），但指标与结论均限于论文所述实验设置。
cards.whyItMatters: 多智能体工作流的效果取决于所有参与角色，而结果反馈通常稀疏且难以归因。该工作提供了一种不依赖额外模型、标签或执行资源的训练思路，将工作流结构转化为可分配的奖励信号，为多角色协同优化提供了可检验的路径。

cards.descriptionEn: This work extends stochastic local volatility (SLV) models by introducing a stochastic correlation process and prices American options through reflected forward-backward stochastic differential equations (RBSDEs). It is useful for capturing richer correlation dynamics and for solving pricing and hedging problems with data-driven numerical methods, including convergence analysis.
cards.description: 该研究将随机相关性过程引入随机局部波动率模型，并用反射倒向随机微分方程（RBSDE）统一刻画美式期权价格，借助数据驱动数值方法求解定价与对冲问题。其价值在于扩展了 SLV 模型的相关性结构，并提供了收敛性分析与数值验证。
cards.summaryEn: The paper studies American option pricing under stochastic local volatility (SLV) models extended with stochastic correlation driven by an additional stochastic process. The authors derive reflected forward-backward stochastic differential equations (RBSDEs) and employ data-driven numerical methods to solve them for pricing and hedging. Numerical experiments illustrate the performance of the extended models and the accuracy and efficiency of the RBSDE-based approach, alongside a convergence analysis.
cards.limitations: 该研究仅基于数值实验和收敛性分析，未提供真实市场数据校准或实证检验；RBSDE 方法在高维情形下的计算可行性、随机相关性过程的设定依据以及与其他 SLV 扩展模型的比较均未在摘要中说明。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work provides an RBSDE framework for pricing and hedging American options under more flexible correlation assumptions, potentially improving the modeling of market correlation dynamics.
keyPoints: 将随机相关性结构引入随机局部波动率模型，扩展了 SLV 模型类。
推导美式期权定价对应的反射倒向随机微分方程（RBSDE）。
采用数据驱动数值方法求解 RBSDE，用于定价与对冲，并进行收敛性分析和数值实验。
cards.title: 随机局部波动率与随机相关性下的美式期权定价：RBSDE框架
keyPointsEn: Introduces a stochastic correlation structure into stochastic local volatility models, generalizing the SLV model class.
Derives reflected forward-backward stochastic differential equations (RBSDEs) for American option pricing.
Solves RBSDEs with data-driven numerical methods for pricing and hedging, including convergence analysis and numerical experiments.
cards.limitationsEn: The study is based only on numerical experiments and convergence analysis, without real-market calibration or empirical testing. The computational feasibility of the RBSDE method in high dimensions, the justification for the stochastic correlation specification, and comparisons with other SLV extensions are not addressed in the abstract.
tags: 反射倒向随机微分方程
cards.titleEn: Pricing American Options under Stochastic Local Volatility and Stochastic Correlation via the RBSDE Framework
cards.originalTitle: On the Pricing of American Options under Stochastic Local Volatility and Stochastic Correlation via the RBSDE Framework
cards.summary: 论文研究随机局部波动率（SLV）模型下美式期权的定价问题，通过引入由额外随机过程驱动的随机相关性来推广 SLV 模型。作者推导对应的反射倒向随机微分方程（RBSDE），并使用数据驱动数值方法求解定价与对冲。数值实验展示了扩展模型的表现以及 RBSDE 方法的精度与效率，文中还包含收敛性分析。
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作为在更灵活的相关性假设下对美式期权进行定价与对冲提供了 RBSDE 框架，可能提升模型对市场相关性动态的刻画能力。

cards.descriptionEn: This study addresses the fragility of bank lending decisions when climate scenario probabilities are unreliable, proposing a minimax-regret framework using public data and NGFS short-term scenarios to assess credit risk in sectoral lending commitments. Its novelty lies in comparing minimax regret with symmetric weighting and maximin under two decision scores, offering an operational decision-fragility tool for financial institutions and supervisors.
cards.description: 该研究针对气候情景概率不可靠时银行贷款决策的脆弱性问题，提出结合公开数据的极小极大遗憾框架，利用NGFS短期情景评估行业贷款承诺的信用风险。其新意在于将极小极大遗憾与对称加权和极大极小策略在两种决策评分下比较，为金融机构和监管者提供操作性的决策脆弱性分析工具。
cards.summaryEn: The paper develops a public-data framework to evaluate incremental bank lending when plausible climate scenarios imply different sector credit outcomes but defensible scenario probabilities are unavailable. The calibration combines 2025 Shared National Credit industry commitments, January 2026 U.S. industry leverage and interest coverage, Damodaran equity volatility, and official 2027 sector-level probability-of-default adjustments from the NGFS CLIMACRED model. The author compares minimax regret with symmetric scenario weighting and maximin under two principal decision scores: expected loss and a credit-compensation payoff.
cards.limitations: 该研究基于公开数据校准，不代表银行实际行为，也不主张普遍最优的气候贷款策略。结果依赖于特定数据源、模型假设和行业分类映射，敏感性分析显示价值条件性。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The framework provides banks and supervisors with an operational decision-fragility assessment method when climate scenario probabilities are missing, helping identify robustness boundaries of loan portfolios under climate uncertainty.
keyPoints: 在12.5%行业上限下，极小极大遗憾相比对称情景加权将最大预期损失遗憾降低29.1%，在信用补偿评分下降低69.1%。
DAPS将承诺加权一年期违约概率从0.0592%提升至0.0897%。
极小极大遗憾的价值取决于情景特定的行业排名在组合约束附近是否不同。
cards.title: 气候情景模糊下的稳健贷款决策：极小极大遗憾框架
keyPointsEn: At a 12.5% sector cap, minimax regret reduces maximum expected-loss regret by 29.1% relative to symmetric scenario weighting, and by 69.1% under the credit-compensation score.
DAPS raises the commitment-weighted one-year PD from 0.0592% to 0.0897%.
The value of minimax regret is conditional on scenario-specific sector rankings differing near binding portfolio constraints.
cards.limitationsEn: The study is calibrated on public data, not evidence about realized bank behavior, and does not claim a universally optimal climate lending strategy. Results depend on specific data sources, model assumptions, and sector crosswalk weights; sensitivity analysis shows conditional value.
cards.titleEn: Modelling Robust Lending Decisions under Climate Scenario Ambiguity: A Minimax-Regret Framework with NGFS Short-Term Scenarios
cards.originalTitle: Modelling Robust Lending Decisions under Climate Scenario Ambiguity: A Minimax-Regret Framework with NGFS Short-Term Scenarios
cards.summary: 论文开发了一个公开数据框架，用于在气候情景概率不可得时评估银行增量贷款。校准结合了2025年共享国民信贷行业承诺、2026年1月美国行业杠杆与利息覆盖率、Damodaran股权波动率以及NGFS CLIMACRED模型的2027年行业违约概率调整。作者比较了极小极大遗憾、对称情景加权和极大极小策略在预期损失与信用补偿支付两种评分下的表现。
cards.whyItMatters: 该框架为银行和监管机构在气候情景概率缺失时提供了一种可操作的决策脆弱性评估方法，有助于识别贷款组合在气候不确定性下的稳健性边界。

cards.descriptionEn: To address the gap that existing safety benchmarks often focus on short, static tasks and fail to capture cumulative risks in long-horizon agents, this work introduces OpenART, an open-ended arena for environment-evolution red teaming, and EMHA, a black-box policy that systematically explores evolving attack surfaces without parameter updates, offering a scalable foundation for agent safety evaluation in complex, evolving environments.
cards.description: 针对现有安全基准多聚焦短时静态任务、难以捕捉长时程智能体累积风险的问题，该工作提出 OpenART 开放式环境演化竞技场，并提供黑盒策略 EMHA 在无需参数更新的条件下系统探索演化攻击面，为复杂动态环境中的智能体安全评估提供可扩展基础。
cards.summaryEn: The paper argues that agents operate in persistent environments where early state changes can influence decisions far into the future, while current safety benchmarks often miss such cumulative risks because they focus on short, static tasks. The authors build OpenART with over 10,000 validated stateful scenarios across 50 domains, drawing from a pool of more than 500,000 tools and skills; tasks require a median of 97 tool calls and support unified evaluation across 75 agent-model configurations. They also propose the Evolutionary Markov Hypergraph Attack (EMHA), a black-box policy that performs feedback-driven environment evolution by coordinating authorized state transitions without parameter updates; during evaluation task objectives remain fixed while only the environment state changes, and EMHA achieves a pooled Attack Success Rate of 85.0%, with its advantage over instruction-only evolution increasing from about 2% on simple environments to over 17% on the most complex ones. The authors' view is that environment evolution increasingly exposes safety failures as task complexity grows, and that an agent's specific runtime implementation explains a significant portion of safety variation.
cards.limitations: 输入仅提供摘要级信息，未给出 1 万个场景的具体筛选标准、EMHA 的完整算法细节、统计不确定性、基线设置或人工复核流程；85.0% 与 2% 至 17% 的优势均来自论文自报评测，需独立复现验证。任务目标固定、仅状态变化的设定也可能无法代表所有真实部署中的攻击面。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work extends agent safety evaluation from short, static tasks to long-horizon, stateful, evolving environments, highlighting that early state changes can create cumulative safety risks. It also indicates that the agent's runtime implementation itself can significantly affect safety beyond the underlying model's capabilities, so evaluation and protection should not rely only on model-level ability.
keyPoints: OpenART 提供 50 个领域、超过 1 万个经校验的有状态场景，工具与技能池超过 50 万，任务中位工具调用数为 97，可统一评估 75 种智能体-模型配置。
EMHA 是黑盒策略，通过反馈驱动的环境演化协调授权状态转移，不需要参数更新；评测中任务目标固定，仅环境状态变化。
汇总攻击成功率 85.0%，相对仅指令演化的优势从简单环境约 2% 增至最复杂环境超过 17%。
cards.title: OpenART：开放式环境演化实现智能体红队规模化
keyPointsEn: OpenART provides over 10,000 validated stateful scenarios across 50 domains, drawing from more than 500,000 tools and skills; tasks require a median of 97 tool calls and enable unified evaluation across 75 agent-model configurations.

EMHA is a black-box policy that performs feedback-driven environment evolution by coordinating authorized state transitions without parameter updates; task objectives remain fixed while only the environment state changes.
The pooled Attack Success Rate is 85.0%, and its advantage over instruction-only evolution increases from about 2% on simple environments to over 17% on the most complex ones.
cards.limitationsEn: Only abstract-level information is provided; the specific screening criteria for the 10,000+ scenarios, full algorithm details of EMHA, statistical uncertainty, baseline setup, and human review processes are not given. The 85.0% ASR and the 2% to 17% advantage are self-reported in the paper and require independent reproduction. The setting with fixed task objectives and only state changes may not represent all real deployment attack surfaces.
cards.titleEn: OpenART: Scaling Agent Red Teaming via Open-Ended Environment Evolution
cards.originalTitle: OpenART: Scaling Agent Red Teaming via Open-Ended Environment Evolution
cards.summary: 论文指出，智能体在持久环境中运行，早期状态变更可能长期影响后续决策，而现有安全基准多基于短时静态任务，难以覆盖此类累积风险。作者构建 OpenART：涵盖 50 个领域、超过 1 万个经校验的有状态场景，工具与技能池超过 50 万，任务中位工具调用数为 97，并支持对 75 种智能体-模型组合进行统一评估。作者还提出 Evolutionary Markov Hypergraph Attack（EMHA）黑盒策略，通过反馈驱动的授权状态转移协调实现环境演化；评测中任务目标固定、仅环境状态改变，EMHA 汇总攻击成功率为 85.0%，相对仅指令演化在简单环境优势约 2%，在最复杂环境优势超过 17%。作者观点是环境演化随任务复杂度提升会暴露更多安全失效，且智能体的具体运行时实现能解释相当一部分安全差异。
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作把智能体安全评估从短时静态任务扩展到长时程、有状态、可演化的环境，提示早期状态变更可能带来累积安全风险；同时表明智能体运行时实现本身也会显著影响安全表现，因此评估与防护不能只看底层模型能力。

cards.descriptionEn: This study embeds causal risk mandates built from overlapping information blocks as closed subspaces of a predictable Hilbert space in a continuous incomplete Brownian market, and derives iff conditions for exact causal decentralization. It helps quantify when decentralized causal execution preserves pooled optimality and how implementation errors decompose.
cards.description: 该研究在连续布朗不完全市场中，将重叠信息块构建的因果风险委托嵌入可预测希尔伯特空间的闭子空间，并给出精确因果去中心化成立当且仅当的四个条件；这为多交易台分散执行因果风险委托提供了理论边界，并区分了可实现与不可实现的误差来源。
cards.summaryEn: The paper studies whether causal risk mandates constructed from overlapping information blocks can be implemented by one self-financing portfolio optimal under pooled information. In an incomplete continuous Brownian market, the author characterizes causal mandates via projections onto traded Brownian directions and proves that exact causal decentralization holds if and only if four conditions are jointly satisfied. The log-growth regret is decomposed into pooled-interaction loss and common-book distortion, while raw causal implementation error also contains non-attainability and incompatibility.
cards.limitations: 结论是连续市场中的局部均衡陈述；精确去中心化依赖汇总扩张保持参考鞅等理想条件，且论文未声称在离散或不完全满足浸入条件时同样成立。二次惩罚下的唯一配置与两交易台比较静态属于特定模型设定，不可直接外推为一般市场中的实现保证或投资建议。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The results provide testable necessary and sufficient conditions and an error decomposition for aggregating decentralized causal risk mandates into one self-financing portfolio, helping quantitative researchers assess when decentralized causal execution preserves optimality and where losses originate.
keyPoints: 精确因果去中心化成立当且仅当汇总扩张保持参考鞅、汇总最优无加性交易台跨度外分量、局部因果影子兼容于同一共同账簿，且该账簿等于加性汇总最优。
在浸入条件下，对数增长遗憾被分解为汇总交互损失与共同账簿扭曲；原始因果实施误差还包含不可达性与不相容性。
二次因果委托惩罚下得到唯一配置，并在含共享、交易台特定与汇总交互风险的两交易台模型中给出精确比较静态。
cards.title: 重叠信息下因果风险委托的精确去中心化条件
keyPointsEn: Exact causal decentralization holds if and only if the pooled enlargement preserves reference martingales, the pooled optimum has no component outside the additive desk span, the local causal shadows are compatible with one common book, and that book equals the additive pooled optimum.
Under immersion, log-growth regret separates into pooled-interaction loss and common-book distortion; raw causal implementation error also includes non-attainability and incompatibility.
A quadratic causal-mandate penalty yields a unique allocation, with exact comparative statics in a two-desk model featuring shared, desk-specific, and pooled-interaction risk.
cards.limitationsEn: The conclusions are partial-equilibrium statements for continuous markets; exact decentralization relies on ideal conditions such as the pooled enlargement preserving reference martingales, and the paper does not claim validity for discrete or non-immersed settings. The unique allocation under quadratic penalty and two-desk comparative statics are specific model results, not general implementation guarantees or investment advice.
cards.titleEn: Exact Decentralization Conditions for Causal Price-of-Risk Mandates under Overlapping Information
cards.originalTitle: Causal Price-of-Risk Mandates under Overlapping Information
cards.summary: 论文研究由重叠信息块构建的因果风险委托能否由一个在汇总信息下最优的自融资组合实现。作者在不完全连续布朗市场中用可预测希尔伯特空间投影刻画因果委托，证明精确因果去中心化等价于四个条件同时成立。作者进一步将对数增长遗憾分解为汇总交互损失与共同账簿扭曲，并指出原始因果实施误差还包含不可达性与不相容性。
cards.whyItMatters: 该结果为将分散的因果风险委托聚合为一个自融资组合提供了可检验的充要条件与误差分解，有助于量化研究者判断在什么市场与信息结构下分散因果执行不损失最优性，以及损失来自哪里。

cards.descriptionEn: The project uses caveman-style prompts and a proxy to compress token consumption of coding agents.
cards.description: 该项目借助“原始人说话”风格提示词与代理，压缩编码代理的Token消耗。
cards.summaryEn: The project condenses coding agent dialogue into minimal phrasing and claims to cut token usage by 65%. This effect is defined and tested by the project itself and has gained attention on GitHub Trending. It reflects a trend of using constrained language to lower large-model inference costs.
cards.limitations: 65%的节省率来自项目作者自述，未提供独立复现、基准条件或任务类型；未说明压缩是否影响代码正确性与代理执行成功率，且条目仅来自GitHub Trending聚合，无同行评审或第三方验证。
cards.whyItMattersEn: When frequent interaction with coding agents is needed, token usage directly affects call costs and response speed; if the compression strategy maintains task quality, it may lower API costs for daily development.
keyPoints: 通过模仿原始人简短表达，代理Token消耗据称降低65%
该项目同时提供技能包与代理两种使用形式
已在GitHub Trending榜获得病毒式传播
cards.title: 用原始人式说话削减六成五Token的开源代理
keyPointsEn: By mimicking caveman-style short expressions, token consumption is reportedly reduced by 65%
The project provides both a skill pack and a proxy as usage forms
It has achieved viral spread on GitHub Trending
cards.limitationsEn: The 65% savings figure is self-reported by the project author without independent reproduction, baseline conditions, or task types; it is unclear whether compression affects code correctness and agent success rates, and the entry comes only from GitHub Trending aggregation with no peer review or third-party validation.
cards.titleEn: Open-source Agent Cuts Token Use by 65% by Talking Like a Caveman
cards.summary: 该项目将编码代理的对话压缩成极简用语，宣称能减少65%的Token用量。这一效果由项目自身定义并测试，在GitHub Trending上受到关注。整体趋势指向利用受限语言降低大模型推理成本。
cards.whyItMatters: 在需要与编码代理进行大量交互时，Token用量直接影响调用成本与响应速度；如果压缩策略能维持任务质量，可能降低日常开发的API开销。

cards.descriptionEn: The repository proposes a design language aimed at helping AI tools produce better design. Its novelty lies in embedding design rules into AI workflows rather than leaving them as human-only references, which is directly useful to developers generating interfaces with AI.
cards.description: 该仓库提出面向 AI 工具的设计语言，旨在让 AI 驱动的开发流程产出更好的设计。新意在于把设计规范直接嵌入 AI 工作流，而非仅作为人工参考；对使用 AI 生成界面的开发者有直接价值。
cards.summaryEn: The GitHub project pbakaus/impeccable presents itself as a design language intended to improve AI tools' design output. The source summary states it makes a user's AI harness better at design. Both claims come from the project itself and lack independent public verification.
cards.limitations: 仅有项目标题与一句来源摘要，缺少方法说明、评测数据、对比结果与适用场景信息。无法判断其有效性、可迁移性及与既有设计系统的差异，也不构成任何采用或投资建议。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If the quality bottleneck in AI-generated interfaces is a lack of design constraints, putting a design language into the AI workflow is a reusable idea; for teams using AI in product design, it may shape how prompts and specifications are organized.
keyPoints: 项目自我定位为面向 AI 工作流的设计语言。
目标是让 AI 工具在设计中产出更好结果。
仓库来自 GitHub Trending Daily，无作者与论文信息。
cards.title: impeccable：让 AI 工具提升设计质量的设计语言
keyPointsEn: The project positions itself as a design language for AI workflows.
Its stated goal is better design output from AI tools.
It appears on GitHub Trending Daily with no author or paper details.
cards.limitationsEn: Only the project title and a one-line source summary are available; there is no method description, evaluation data, comparison, or scope information. Its effectiveness, transferability, and difference from existing design systems cannot be judged, and this is not an adoption or investment recommendation.
cards.titleEn: impeccable: A Design Language to Make AI Tools Better at Design
cards.summary: GitHub 上的 pbakaus/impeccable 项目将自身定位为一种设计语言，用来提升 AI 工具的设计能力。项目来源摘要称其能让用户的 AI 工作流在设计方面表现更好。以上均为项目自身的表述，尚无独立验证公开。
cards.whyItMatters: 若 AI 生成界面的质量瓶颈在于缺乏设计约束，把设计语言前置到 AI 工作流是一种可复用的思路；对依赖 AI 辅助做产品设计的团队，可能影响其提示与规范组织方式。
